title: 142 by Biosemi
description: EEG recordings from 142 participants who received laser-evoked pain stimuli at fixed low and high intensities and rated the pain intensity after each stimulus. Each participant completed 3 blocks of 10 stimuli, with high and low pain stimuli evenly distributed within each block. Data were recorded with a Biosemi system and are intended for studying the neural correlates of pain perception.
methods_description: Participants received laser stimuli at 3 J (low) and 3.5 J (high); participants 136-142 received 3.5 J (low) and 4 J (high). Each participant completed 3 blocks of 10 stimuli (30 total). They kept their eyes open and fixated on a crosshair. After each stimulus they rated pain on a 0-10 scale (0 = no sensation, 4 = pain onset, 6 = moderate, 8 = severe, 10 = unbearable). The next trial began at a random interval about 5 seconds after the rating.
